validity.researcher_notes: Apex is a real, proposed gas transmission pipeline by Targa Resources. All specifications verified against EIA Aug 2026 release (capacity 2000 MMcf/d, length 563 mi, diameter 42 in, cost $2500M all match). However, status has changed from proposed: EIA Aug 2026 (released 2026-07-31, data as of 2026-08) shows status 'On Hold' (shelved), not 'proposed' as the sheet records. The project received a TX RRC T4-10456 permit in 2023 (expiration 2/28/25, renewed per EIA), but construction has not started. In-service target per EIA May 2026 was 2027, with a note that 'in-service date could slip to 2027 or 2028' due to competing pipelines (Aug 2026 release confirms permit renewal but on-hold status). The status change is material and owed a sourced update. [ORCHESTRATOR AUDIT 2026-09-15] Tier arithmetic corrected (tier 'high' -> 'medium'; independent True -> False): this record's evidence resolves to 1 distinct publisher(s) (eia.gov), and rule 4 counts publishers, not URLs — every EIA release is ONE origin, as are multiple filings by one filer or multiple notices in one docket. The FINDING is unchanged; only the confidence claim was wrong.
